title: CXOTalk Books Eric Ries for June 26 Episode
summary: Michael Krigsman's CXOTalk announces Eric for its June 26 slot — slotted alongside Box CEO Aaron Levie (June 12) and McKinsey AI lead Alex Singla (June 19) in CXOTalk's June lineup.
blockquote:
Here's a peek at who'll be on #CXOTalk this June 2026:

* @Levie of @Box - 12 June
* @AlexSingla of @McKinsey - 19 June
* Eric Ries, author of "Lean Startup" and now "Incorruptible" - 26 June
attribution_title: Long-running interview show with technology and business leaders, hosted by Michael Krigsman
